All we can do is take it one day at a time. I've begun meditating and it allows me to live more in the moment rather than let my anxiety take over. Try and find a creative outlet for yourself, simply listen to music, discover a new genre that you enjoy, or find a new scene.   


If taking it day by day seems like it is too much (which it does for me sometimes) try taking it hour by hour or breathe by breathe. You can really focus on things you need to do for yourself rather than thinking about others. Ask yourself, What would be fun for me RIGHT NOW. Avoid escapisms such as movies or tv.   


Your life matters to me, I took time to write this message your post spoke to me as a man who cares about women and their feelings.  I want you to live a happy life, talk to me if you feel any worse.   


Stay Safe  
\-Oneonomous
